+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -12,5 +12,35 @@
     tau_filter: float,
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
+    # Validate inputs
+    for arr, name in [
+        (logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
+        (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
+        (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call"),
+    ]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
+        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
+        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only nonpositive values")
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All matrices must have the same shape")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
+    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a scalar")
+    if not np.isreal(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a real number")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

+    margin = np.minimum(

+        np.sum(logp_with_result - logp_call_only, axis=1),
+    )
+    keep = margin >= tau_filter
+    return keep, margin
